contract_limits.directory_identity: Only held local directory metadata, root-to-leaf <=129, path<=32768bytes, decimal u64 strings; all named/held chain comparisons; no symlink/alias fallback

contract_limits.raw_guard: New method only after original token match and final exact method; typed reparse preserves duplicate keys. Same seven real Request fields; rejects CAS/idempotency presence even explicit null; old routes untouched
